notes.observation: Review found newly declared settings could accidentally consume stored shadow values and private symlinks could point outside the captured settings tree.
notes.resolution: Supply only old declared settings to selected candidates, allow new defaults only, reject private-input/build symlinks; final full/race runs cover both.

implementation_notes: Explicit name xor --all; --ref is single Git only. No path/URL/type/settings/route override and no Detect or implicit layout migration.

Selected managed copy/Git drift is rejected before acquisition; unselected content comes exclusively from authenticated approval bytes. Missing ordered native baseline is conservative unless explicitly selected.
Joint compilation checks effective/rendered/native and dedup ownership of unselected packages before any commit; only selected approval/settings records are rewritten.
Settings are captured once: retain still-declared old keys, remove dropped keys, default-only new keys. New required keys cannot consume ambient or stored undeclared values.
Detached confirmation applies the same captured candidate; Git ref is not re-resolved. No-op verifies inputs while preserving installation bytes, permissions, timestamps and identity.

App coordinates shared management guard, full input verification and all package stages/exchanges. agenthooks keeps codecs/rendering/owner/trust/ApplyFiles; only typed recovery reporting, original backup mode/mtime and failed-backup retention were added.
Runtime state/stats/probe are not maintained; no new runtime index/lock/approval format or public test bypass is introduced.
limits: Same-version cooperative-process guard; no same-user authentication or multi-file power-loss atomicity.
Git update may acquire/cache while installation remains unchanged; it is not offline frozen recovery.
An authenticated approval is required for each unselected package; legacy native ordering requires explicit selection.
Tests use private fixtures/version stubs and raw hook invocation; real harness trust/loading/delivery, Windows, CI and official counts are not closed.
